scope: Logical typed delivery-router endpoint descriptor contract only. No router behavior, payload storage realization, physical port or FIFO count, HBM/controller behavior, scheduler, source plan, numeric datapath, timing, throughput, PPA, model/GPU, RTL correctness, or new A4 DSE claim.

router.name: route_a_typed_delivery_router
owns: hold exact registry-resolved typed delivery until exact endpoint acceptance
forward immutable R1 response fields and registry descriptor without reinterpretation
return exact final-endpoint acceptance to registry
does_not_own: R1 request identity or response status creation
R2 eligibility FIFO credit cursor or read rotation
source READY deliverable release or four-consumer completion
authority transition metadata publication or descriptor durability
R4 numeric result or R6 terminal lifecycle

registry_resolution.release_rule: release only after exact target accepts the final R1 read fragment or write terminal, or destructive reset; retain the ref across accepted non-final read fragments

typed_read_fragment.name: TypedReadFragment
typed_read_fragment.ok_rule: on status==OK, forward data_512b unchanged to exactly the descriptor-selected replaceable functional payload or transport endpoint
typed_read_fragment.fault_rule: on non-OK status, do not deposit payload; forward exact owner-local control fault observation without READY, source-deliverable, authority, retry, or fallback creation
typed_read_fragment.control_after_payload_accept: the matching control-only P3PendingFragment, S2FillTerminal, or DirectPendingRecordTerminal observation may occur only after the endpoint accepts the matching typed handoff

typed_write_terminal.name: TypedWriteTerminal
typed_write_terminal.fault_rule: forward exact status with durable=false; no visibility, authority, retry, or fallback

required_follow_on.requires: Bind the registry and router to these exact descriptors, introduce owner-local replaceable functional payload/transport wrappers, and test endpoint acceptance plus stale/fault/stall cases before activating any top-inert delivery carrier.
required_follow_on.not_authorized: No physical data storage, macro/port choice, controller behavior, endpoint scheduling, source-deliverable behavior, numeric datapath, timing, throughput, PPA, or performance result.
